description: This file declares functions and macros related to quoting and dequoting strings, primarily for shell safety, path quoting, and language-specific string literals. It appears to be a header file defining interfaces for quoting operations in a C-based project.

methods.name: sq_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a string for shell safety, replacing special characters and enclosing it in single quotes.

methods.name: sq_quote_argv
methods.description: Quotes an array of strings for shell safety.

methods.name: sq_quotef
methods.description: Formats and quotes a string with printf-style formatting for shell safety.

methods.name: sq_dequote
methods.description: Removes quoting from a string produced by sq_quote, if it matches the expected pattern.

methods.name: sq_dequote_step
methods.description: Dequotes a single quoted item from a string and provides a pointer to the next position.

methods.name: sq_dequote_to_argv
methods.description: Dequotes multiple shell-quoted arguments into an argv array.

methods.name: quote_c_style
methods.description: Quotes a string for C-style string literals, with optional flags.

methods.name: quote_two_c_style
methods.description: Quotes two strings for C-style string literals, possibly for comparison or pairing.

methods.name: write_name_quoted
methods.description: Writes a quoted name to a file stream.

methods.name: write_name_quoted_relative
methods.description: Writes a relative path name in quoted form.

methods.name: quote_path
methods.description: Quotes a path as relative or absolute, based on a prefix, for safe usage.

methods.name: perl_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a string for use in Perl contexts.

methods.name: perl_quote_buf_with_len
methods.description: Quotes a string with specified length for Perl contexts.

methods.name: python_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a string for use as a Python string literal.

methods.name: tcl_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a string for Tcl scripts.

methods.name: basic_regex_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a string for use in regular expressions.
